faqs.question: Do I need GST registration?
faqs.answer: Registration is mandatory once aggregate turnover crosses the prescribed threshold (₹40 lakh for goods and ₹20 lakh for services in most states), for inter-state supply of goods, and for e-commerce sellers. Voluntary registration can also make sense to claim input credit.

faqs.question: How often are GST returns filed?
faqs.answer: Most regular taxpayers file GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B monthly. Small taxpayers under the QRMP scheme file quarterly with monthly tax payments. Composition dealers file CMP-08 quarterly and GSTR-4 annually.

resources.title: Compliance calendar for FY 2026-27: every due date in one place

data.title: Compliance calendar for FY 2026-27: every due date in one place
data.excerpt: Income tax, GST, TDS and ROC deadlines for the year, organised month by month so you can plan cash flow and paperwork.
body: Missing a statutory deadline is expensive: late fees, interest and in some cases loss of input credit or director disqualification. This calendar consolidates the recurring due dates every Indian business and taxpayer should track.

Monthly: GSTR-1 (11th), GSTR-3B (20th), TDS deposit (7th), PF and ESI (15th). Quarterly: TDS statements, advance tax instalments (15 June, 15 September, 15 December, 15 March). Annual: ITR (31 July for non-audit cases), tax audit (30 September), GSTR-9 (31 December), AOC-4 and MGT-7 (within 30 and 60 days of the AGM).
Dates can shift when the government issues extensions. Our clients receive reminders through the portal seven days before every applicable deadline.

resources.title: Old vs. new tax regime: a practical way to decide

data.title: Old vs. new tax regime: a practical way to decide
data.excerpt: The new regime is the default, but the old one still wins for many taxpayers with HRA and large deductions. Here is how to compare.
body: The new regime offers lower slab rates but removes most deductions and exemptions. The old regime keeps deductions such as 80C, 80D, HRA and home-loan interest but taxes income at higher rates.

A quick heuristic: add up the deductions and exemptions you can genuinely claim. If they exceed roughly ₹3.75–4 lakh on a ₹15 lakh salary, the old regime is usually better. Below that, the new regime typically wins.
Salaried taxpayers can switch every year; those with business income can switch out of the new regime only once. Run both computations before filing rather than assuming.

resources.title: GSTR-2B reconciliation: a checklist to protect your input tax credit

data.title: GSTR-2B reconciliation: a checklist to protect your input tax credit
data.excerpt: Input credit is only as good as your vendors' filings. A monthly reconciliation routine keeps your credit safe and your 3B accurate.
body: GSTR-2B is the auto-drafted statement of eligible input tax credit for a tax period. Credit not appearing in it is generally not available, regardless of what your purchase register says.

Each month, match purchase invoices to GSTR-2B by GSTIN, invoice number and taxable value. Classify differences as missing in portal, missing in books, mismatch, or duplicate, and follow up with vendors before filing GSTR-3B.
Keep a running list of vendors who consistently file late. Consider withholding the tax component of their payments until credit reflects.

resources.title: Private Limited vs. LLP: choosing a structure for your startup

data.title: Private Limited vs. LLP: choosing a structure for your startup
data.excerpt: Investors prefer companies; consultants often prefer LLPs. Compare compliance cost, taxation and fundraising flexibility before you decide.
body: A Private Limited company allows equity fundraising, ESOPs and is the structure most venture investors expect. It carries higher annual compliance: board meetings, statutory audit regardless of turnover, and detailed ROC filings.
An LLP is simpler and cheaper to maintain, taxed at a flat rate with no dividend distribution complications, but cannot issue ESOPs or raise equity in the conventional sense.
If you plan to raise institutional money within 18 months, incorporate a company. If you are a services partnership without external investors, an LLP is often the better fit.

resources.title: ROC annual filings for small companies: forms, timelines and penalties

data.title: ROC annual filings for small companies: forms, timelines and penalties
data.excerpt: AOC-4, MGT-7A, DIR-3 KYC and ADT-1 explained for directors who want to stay compliant without surprises.
body: Every company must hold an AGM within six months of the financial year end and file its financial statements (AOC-4) within 30 days and annual return (MGT-7 or MGT-7A for small companies) within 60 days of the AGM.
Directors must complete DIR-3 KYC annually by 30 September. Auditor appointments are reported in ADT-1.
Late filing attracts ₹100 per day per form with no ceiling. Repeated non-filing for two years can lead to strike-off and director disqualification for five years.

resources.title: Advance tax for freelancers and consultants: how to avoid interest

data.title: Advance tax for freelancers and consultants: how to avoid interest
data.excerpt: If your tax liability exceeds ₹10,000 in a year, you must pay in instalments. Here is a simple system to stay ahead.
body: Advance tax is due in four instalments: 15% by 15 June, 45% by 15 September, 75% by 15 December and 100% by 15 March. Presumptive taxpayers under section 44ADA can pay the full amount by 15 March.
Estimate annual income conservatively each quarter, subtract TDS already deducted by clients, and pay the balance through Challan 280.
Shortfalls attract interest under sections 234B and 234C at 1% per month. Setting aside 20–25% of every receipt in a separate account makes this painless.

resources.title: E-invoicing: what businesses crossing the threshold must do

data.title: E-invoicing: what businesses crossing the threshold must do
data.excerpt: Once your aggregate turnover crosses the notified limit, every B2B invoice needs an IRN. Here is the setup checklist.
body: E-invoicing applies to registered persons whose aggregate turnover in any preceding financial year from 2017-18 crossed the notified threshold. Applicability is permanent once triggered.
Register on the Invoice Registration Portal, integrate your billing software or use the offline utility, and ensure invoices carry the IRN and QR code before they are shared with customers.
Cancellation is allowed within 24 hours; after that, issue a credit note. Build this into your billing team's process from day one.

data.label: Total sales in the year (business)
data.hint: Everything your shop or business sold from 1 April to 31 March, before any expenses.
data.whereToFind: Your sales register, GST returns (GSTR-1 / GSTR-3B totals) or bank statement credits.
data.example: If you sold goods worth ₹32,50,000 in the year, type 3250000.
data.hindi: साल भर की कुल बिक्री (खर्चा घटाने से पहले)। GST रिटर्न या बिक्री रजिस्टर से लें।

data.label: Profit from business
data.hint: Sales minus your business expenses (purchases, rent, salaries, electricity). If you use the simple 'presumptive' scheme, at least 6% of digital sales / 8% of cash sales.
data.whereToFind: Profit & loss statement from your accountant, or estimate: total sales − total expenses.
data.hindi: बिक्री में से खर्चा घटाने के बाद जो बचा, वह मुनाफ़ा। छोटे व्यापारी 6%/8% वाला आसान (presumptive) तरीका भी चुन सकते हैं।

data.label: Fees received (doctor, lawyer, freelancer, consultant)
data.hint: Total fees you received for professional work in the year. Leave 0 if you only run a shop / trading business.
data.whereToFind: Invoices you raised, or Form 26AS / AIS on the income-tax portal (payments where TDS was cut).
data.example: A freelance designer paid ₹9,00,000 in the year types 900000.
data.hindi: पेशेवर काम (डॉक्टर, वकील, फ्रीलांस) की कुल फ़ीस। दुकान/व्यापार वाले 0 छोड़ें।

data.label: Profit from profession
data.hint: Fees minus your work expenses. Under the simple scheme (Section 44ADA) you can declare 50% of fees as profit and skip bookkeeping.
data.hindi: फ़ीस में से खर्चा घटाकर मुनाफ़ा। आसान तरीके में फ़ीस का 50% मुनाफ़ा मान सकते हैं।

field_guides.title: Tax you already paid yourself (advance / self-assessment tax)

data.label: Tax you already paid yourself (advance / self-assessment tax)
data.hint: Any income tax you paid directly through a bank challan during the year. Leave 0 if you never paid tax yourself.
data.whereToFind: Form 26AS on incometax.gov.in → 'Part C – Taxes paid', or the challan receipt (Challan 280) from your bank.
data.example: Paid ₹40,000 in December and ₹35,000 in March → type 75000.
data.hindi: जो टैक्स आपने खुद बैंक चालान से जमा किया (एडवांस टैक्स)। Form 26AS में दिखता है।

field_guides.title: TDS cut by customers or banks

data.label: TDS cut by customers or banks
data.hint: Tax that others deducted before paying you (customers deducting 1–2% on your bills, banks on FD interest). This is already paid on your behalf and reduces what you owe.
data.whereToFind: Form 26AS / AIS on incometax.gov.in, or Form 16A certificates given by the payer.
data.hindi: ग्राहकों या बैंक ने भुगतान से पहले जो टैक्स काटा (TDS)। Form 26AS में देखें।

data.label: Interest from savings bank account
data.hint: Interest the bank added to your savings account in the year (all banks together).
data.whereToFind: Bank passbook / statement — look for lines called 'Int.Pd' or 'Interest credit', usually every 3 months. Or your AIS on the income-tax portal.
data.hindi: बचत खाते पर बैंक ने जो ब्याज दिया (सारे बैंक जोड़कर)। पासबुक में 'Int' लाइन देखें।

data.label: Interest from fixed deposits (FD)
data.hint: Interest earned on FDs this year, even if the FD has not matured yet.
data.whereToFind: Bank's 'Interest certificate' (downloadable from net banking) or Form 26AS / AIS.
data.hindi: FD पर मिला ब्याज (चाहे FD अभी पूरी न हुई हो)। बैंक का interest certificate देखें।

field_guides.title: Interest from recurring deposits (RD) or post office

data.label: Interest from recurring deposits (RD) or post office
data.hint: Interest on RDs, post-office schemes (NSC, KVP, MIS). Leave 0 if none.
data.whereToFind: RD passbook or post-office statement.
data.hindi: RD या पोस्ट ऑफिस योजनाओं का ब्याज। न हो तो 0 छोड़ें।

field_guides.title: Profit on shares / mutual funds sold within 1 year

data.label: Profit on shares / mutual funds sold within 1 year
data.hint: Money you gained by selling shares, mutual funds or property you held for a short time. Only the profit, not the sale amount.
data.whereToFind: 'Capital gains statement' from your broker (Zerodha, Groww, etc.) or mutual fund house (CAMS / KFintech).
data.example: Bought shares for ₹1,00,000, sold for ₹1,20,000 after 6 months → gain ₹20,000 → type 20000.
data.hindi: 1 साल के अंदर बेचे गए शेयर/म्यूचुअल फंड पर हुआ मुनाफ़ा (सिर्फ़ मुनाफ़ा, बिक्री रकम नहीं)।

field_guides.title: Profit on shares / mutual funds / property held over 1 year

data.label: Profit on shares / mutual funds / property held over 1 year
data.hint: Profit from selling things you held for more than a year (2 years for property). Gains up to ₹1.25 lakh on shares are tax-free.
data.whereToFind: Same capital gains statement from the broker / fund house; for property, the sale deed and purchase deed.
data.hindi: 1 साल से ज़्यादा रखे शेयर/फंड या 2 साल से ज़्यादा रखी प्रॉपर्टी बेचने पर मुनाफ़ा।

data.label: Rent you received (whole year)
data.hint: Total rent from a house or shop you own and let out. Type the yearly amount, not monthly.
data.whereToFind: Rent agreement or bank credits from the tenant.
data.hindi: अपनी दुकान/मकान किराये पर देकर साल भर में मिला कुल किराया (मासिक नहीं, सालाना)।

data.label: Any other income
data.hint: Anything else: commission, lottery, cash gifts over ₹50,000 from non-relatives, family pension, dividend from shares.
data.whereToFind: Your bank statement; dividends appear in AIS on the income-tax portal.
data.hindi: बाकी कोई आय: कमीशन, डिविडेंड, ₹50,000 से ऊपर के गिफ्ट, लॉटरी आदि।

field_guides.title: Rent you paid for your home (whole year)

data.label: Rent you paid for your home (whole year)
data.hint: Only if you live in a rented house AND your salary includes HRA. Business owners without salary can leave 0.
data.whereToFind: Rent receipts or bank transfers to your landlord. Landlord PAN is needed if rent is over ₹1,00,000 a year.
data.hindi: अगर आप किराये के घर में रहते हैं और सैलरी में HRA मिलता है, तो साल भर का दिया किराया।

field_guides.title: Savings that reduce tax — LIC, PPF, ELSS, child school fees, home-loan principal (80C)

data.label: Savings that reduce tax — LIC, PPF, ELSS, child school fees, home-loan principal (80C)
data.hint: Add up what you paid this year into these: life-insurance premium, PPF, ELSS mutual funds, tax-saver FD, NSC, children's tuition fees, home-loan principal. Maximum benefit ₹1,50,000.
data.whereToFind: Premium receipts, PPF passbook, school fee receipts, home-loan statement ('principal repaid').
data.hindi: LIC, PPF, ELSS, बच्चों की स्कूल फ़ीस, होम लोन का मूल (principal) — सब जोड़कर। अधिकतम ₹1.5 लाख का फ़ायदा।

field_guides.title: Money put into NPS pension account (80CCD(1B))

data.label: Money put into NPS pension account (80CCD(1B))
data.hint: Your own NPS deposits this year. Extra ₹50,000 benefit over and above 80C. Leave 0 if you don't have NPS.
data.whereToFind: NPS statement from the NSDL / Protean CRA app or SMS.
data.hindi: NPS पेंशन खाते में डाला पैसा। 80C के ऊपर ₹50,000 तक अलग से फ़ायदा।

field_guides.title: Health insurance premium (mediclaim) for family and parents (80D)

data.label: Health insurance premium (mediclaim) for family and parents (80D)
data.hint: Premium paid for health insurance of you, spouse, children and parents. Up to ₹25,000 for family, plus ₹50,000 for senior-citizen parents.
data.whereToFind: Policy premium receipt or the '80D certificate' from your insurer's app.
data.hindi: अपने परिवार और माता-पिता के हेल्थ इंश्योरेंस (मेडिक्लेम) का प्रीमियम।

data.label: Savings-account interest benefit (80TTA)
data.hint: Type the same savings-account interest you entered above, up to ₹10,000 — that much is tax-free. Senior citizens get ₹50,000 (80TTB).
data.hindi: ऊपर लिखा बचत खाते का ब्याज यहाँ दोबारा लिखें (₹10,000 तक टैक्स-फ्री)।

data.label: Interest paid on home loan (Section 24)
data.hint: Only the interest part of your home-loan EMIs this year (not the principal). Maximum ₹2,00,000 for a self-occupied house.
data.whereToFind: 'Provisional interest certificate' from your bank's net banking / app.
data.hindi: होम लोन की EMI में ब्याज (interest) वाला हिस्सा। बैंक का interest certificate देखें।

data.label: Other deductions (donations, education-loan interest, disability)
data.hint: Donations to approved charities (80G), interest on an education loan (80E), disability (80U). Leave 0 if none.
data.whereToFind: Donation receipt with the charity's 80G registration number; education-loan interest certificate.
data.hindi: दान (80G), एजुकेशन लोन का ब्याज (80E), दिव्यांगता (80U) आदि।

data.label: Your GST number (GSTIN)
data.hint: The 15-character number on your GST registration certificate. It starts with your state code (e.g. 27 for Maharashtra) and contains your PAN.
data.whereToFind: GST registration certificate (Form REG-06), or on any invoice you have issued. Also on gst.gov.in after login.
data.hindi: आपका 15 अंकों का GST नंबर, GST सर्टिफिकेट या अपने बिल पर लिखा होता है।

data.label: Legal name (as on PAN)
data.hint: The name printed on your PAN card / GST certificate — for a proprietor this is your own name.
data.whereToFind: GST certificate, 'Legal Name of Business' line.
data.hindi: PAN कार्ड / GST सर्टिफिकेट पर लिखा नाम। प्रोप्राइटर के लिए आपका अपना नाम।

data.label: Shop / brand name (trade name)
data.hint: The name on your shop board or bills, if different from the legal name.
data.hindi: दुकान के बोर्ड या बिल पर लिखा नाम, अगर कानूनी नाम से अलग है।

data.label: Type of business
data.hint: Proprietorship (single owner), Partnership, LLP, Private Limited, HUF, etc.
data.whereToFind: GST certificate, 'Constitution of Business' line.
data.hindi: व्यवसाय का प्रकार: प्रोप्राइटरशिप, पार्टनरशिप, प्राइवेट लिमिटेड आदि।

data.label: State of registration
data.hint: The state where your business is registered — decides whether a sale is 'within state' (CGST + SGST) or 'to another state' (IGST).
data.hindi: जिस राज्य में GST रजिस्ट्रेशन है।

data.label: Registered business address
data.hint: Address printed on the GST certificate ('Principal Place of Business').
data.hindi: GST सर्टिफिकेट पर लिखा मुख्य कारोबार का पता।

data.label: Person who signs the return
data.hint: The owner or partner responsible for filing — usually you.
data.hindi: रिटर्न पर हस्ताक्षर करने वाला व्यक्ति — आम तौर पर मालिक।

data.label: Their role
data.hint: Proprietor, Partner, Director, Manager…
data.hindi: उनका पद: प्रोप्राइटर, पार्टनर, डायरेक्टर…

data.label: Which return?
data.hint: GSTR-1 = list of your sales (monthly/quarterly). GSTR-3B = summary where you pay the tax. GSTR-4 = yearly return for composition-scheme shops. GSTR-9 = yearly summary.
data.whereToFind: Most regular shops file GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B every month; if you opted for the composition scheme, file GSTR-4.
data.hindi: GSTR-1 = बिक्री की सूची, GSTR-3B = टैक्स भरने वाला सारांश, GSTR-4 = कंपोज़िशन स्कीम का सालाना रिटर्न।

data.label: Month the return is for
data.hint: Pick the month whose sales/purchases you are reporting — not the month you are filing in.
data.example: Filing in May for April's sales → pick April.
data.hindi: जिस महीने की बिक्री/खरीद बता रहे हैं वह महीना चुनें (फाइल करने का महीना नहीं)।

data.label: What is this document?
data.hint: Sales = bill you gave a customer. Purchase = bill a supplier gave you. Credit note = you reduced a customer's bill / took goods back. Debit note = you charged extra.
data.hindi: Sales = आपने ग्राहक को दिया बिल। Purchase = सप्लायर से मिला बिल। Credit note = बिल घटाया/सामान वापस लिया।

data.label: Does GST apply to it?
data.hint: Taxable = normal GST bill. Exempt / Nil-rated = items with no GST (fresh vegetables, milk, books). Zero-rated = exports. Reverse charge = the buyer pays the GST (e.g. transporter, lawyer bills).
data.hindi: Taxable = सामान्य GST बिल। Exempt/Nil = जिन पर GST नहीं (सब्ज़ी, दूध)। Zero-rated = एक्सपोर्ट।

data.label: Bill number
data.hint: The invoice number printed on the bill. Sales bills must be in a running series for the year.
data.hindi: बिल पर छपा इनवॉइस नंबर।

data.label: Bill date
data.hint: Date printed on the bill.
data.hindi: बिल की तारीख।

data.label: Customer's / supplier's GST number
data.hint: The other party's GSTIN, if they are GST-registered (B2B). Leave blank for walk-in customers without GST (B2C).
data.whereToFind: Printed on their bill or letterhead; verify on gst.gov.in → 'Search Taxpayer'.
data.hindi: दूसरी पार्टी का GST नंबर (अगर है)। बिना GST वाले ग्राहक के लिए खाली छोड़ें।

data.label: Customer's / supplier's name
data.hint: Name on their bill. For walk-in cash sales you can write 'Cash sale'.
data.hindi: ग्राहक/सप्लायर का नाम। नकद बिक्री के लिए 'Cash sale' लिख सकते हैं।

data.label: Where the goods were delivered (state)
data.hint: The state where the buyer received the goods or service. Same state as yours → CGST + SGST. Another state → IGST.
data.hindi: जिस राज्य में सामान/सेवा पहुँची। अपना राज्य → CGST+SGST; दूसरा राज्य → IGST।

field_guides.title: HSN / SAC code of the item

data.label: HSN / SAC code of the item
data.hint: The government's item code: HSN for goods, SAC for services. Businesses under ₹5 crore need 4 digits; above that 6 digits.
data.whereToFind: On your supplier's bill, in your billing software, or search 'HSN code <item>' on cbic-gst.gov.in.
data.hindi: सामान का सरकारी कोड (HSN) या सेवा का कोड (SAC)। सप्लायर के बिल पर मिल जाता है।

data.label: Bill amount before GST
data.hint: Value of the goods/services only, without adding GST.
data.hindi: GST जोड़ने से पहले की रकम।

data.label: CGST (central GST) on the bill
data.hint: For sales within your own state, GST is split into two equal halves — this is the central half.
data.hindi: अपने राज्य में बिक्री पर GST का आधा हिस्सा (केंद्र)।

data.label: SGST (state GST) on the bill
data.hint: The state's half — always equal to CGST for within-state sales.
data.hindi: अपने राज्य में बिक्री पर GST का आधा हिस्सा (राज्य)। CGST के बराबर।

data.label: IGST (for sales to another state)
data.hint: Used instead of CGST + SGST when the buyer is in a different state. Leave 0 for within-state bills.
data.example: 18% GST on ₹10,000 sold to Delhi from Mumbai → IGST ₹1,800.
data.hindi: दूसरे राज्य में बिक्री पर पूरा GST यहाँ। अपने राज्य के बिल के लिए 0।

data.text: Let's file your income tax return
Answer a few simple questions. We will pick the right form and work out your tax — no accountant language.
I get a salary (I have Form 16)
Upload the Form 16 PDF your employer gave you. We read it and fill everything for you.
I run a business, shop or work for myself
No Form 16 needed. You'll just tell us your total sales, profit and any tax already paid.
Try the flow with a sample Form 16 to see how it works.
Fill only what applies to you — leave the rest as 0. Tap the ⓘ next to any box to see where the number comes from.
For shopkeepers, traders, contractors, doctors, freelancers. Round figures are fine — we'll refine them at review.
Banks report this to the tax department, so include it even if it's small.
Profit from selling shares, mutual funds or property
Skip if you didn't sell any investments this year.
Rent you pay for your home (salaried with HRA only)
I live in Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai or Kolkata
I live in another city or town
Tax cut by others or paid by you during the year. We subtract this so you only pay the balance (or get a refund).
Expenses that reduce your tax (old regime)
Insurance, savings, school fees, home loan — the government lets you subtract these from income. We'll also check if the new regime (no deductions, lower rates) is better for you.
Step 1: start a return for a month. Step 2: add your bills. Step 3: check and send it for filing.
Pick your GST number, the return type and the month. The due date is shown automatically.
Add every sales bill you issued and every purchase bill you received for the month. Tap ⓘ on any box for help.
Same-state bill: fill CGST and SGST (equal halves). Other-state bill: fill only IGST.
Export as CSV and upload — we read the columns by name (document type, invoice number, date, taxable value, CGST, SGST, IGST, GSTIN, place of supply). Duplicates are skipped.
Copy these details from your GST certificate once; every return will use them.

Jo lagoo nahi hota, use 0 chhod do. Andaaz se bhi likh sakte ho, baad mein badal sakte ho.
Form 16 Part B → 'Gross salary'. Ya 12 mahine ki salary jod lo.
